The Undersecretary for Agriculture shall chair
the Committee when the Secretary of Agriculture and
Natural Resources is absent or unable to attend to
the Committees meetings.
The Committee shall have exclusive jurisdiction
over all cases involving public lands and other lands
of the public domain. It shall perform the follow-
ing functions:
1. To investigate, coordinate, and resolve ex-
peditiously land disputes.

J. To study and review present policies as
embodied in land laws and administrative rules and
regulations, in relation to the needs for land of
the agro-industrial scotor and small farmers, with
the end in view to evolving and recommending new
laws and policies and establishing priorities in
the erant of public land, and the simplification of
pressing of land applications in order to relieve
the small man from the complexities of existing laws,
rules and regulationa;
4. To evolve and implement a system for the
apeedy investigation and resolution of land disputes;
5. To receive all complaints of settlers and
small fermers, involving public lands or other lands
of the public domain;

The Chairman of the Committee shall have the
power and authority to appoint or designate its
officers and staff members and to presoribe their
rates of emoluments and/or allowances, and to cre-
ate such positions and subcommittees as may be
necessary to accomplish the objectives of the com-

ance and/or detail of personnel shall forthwith be
extended whenever tho same is sought by the Commit-
Special releases of funds in connection with
the Committeels functions which cannot be funded
by regular appropriations is hereby authorized.
Executive Order No. 238 dated June 18, 1970,
as amended by Executive Order No. 246 dated July
16, 1970; and Memorandum Circular No. 352, dated
May 15, 1970 are Hereby revoked,
Any executive order, administrative order,
memorendum circular or other orders and circulars
or portions thereof, inconsistent herewith are
hereby modified to conform to the provisions of
this Executive Order.
